text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] SLA breach detected for tenant "SparkRide" — elevated 5xx rate (18%) over last 5m, paging #eng-oncall.
alice: pinging @ben and @sam. I see multiple tenant-specific checks firing, looks noisy.
ben: on it. grabbing logs from the affected shard. initial glance: increased kv cache evictions + worker queue pile-up, might be retry amplification.
sam: can we temporarily throttle their background checks? proddash shows frontend errors rising, customer impact visible: https://grafana/redwood/d/sparkr (short link)
alice: ops playbook: (1) apply silence to avoid pager flood (2) throttle check frequency for tenant (3) spin up mitigation dashboard + ticket. I'll take silence.
tammy: FYI support already got inbound calls — customer impact ~= 2% transaction failures over last 10m. any ETA on mitigation?
ben: running PD silence for tenant-specific check group now:
```
/pagerduty silence --service "tenant-health" --filter "tenant:SparkRide" --duration 30m
```
ben: silence applied. incident-bot should stop new pages for that alert group.
incident-bot: Update: Silence applied by ben; watchers: alice, ben, sam.
sam: next step: reduce check aggressiveness for SparkRide. current config snippet:
```
tenant_checks:
  SparkRide:
    interval: 30s
    retry_policy: aggressive
```
sam: proposed temporary override: interval -> 90s, retry_policy -> exponential_backoff for 1h, then auto-revert. reduces load and retry storms.
alice: +1. Ben can you canary the change to a single region first (us-west)?
ben: applying override to staging then canary to us-west:
```
kubectl apply -f tenant-sparkr-override.yaml --namespace=prod --context=us-west --record
```
ben: canary deployed to us-west, watching metrics.
alice: canary telemetry: 5xx down from 18% -> 1.8% in ~7 minutes. worker queue length reduced.
tammy: good. I'll draft a short customer note: "We're throttling non-essential background checks to reduce errors; investigating root cause." Will liaise with support.
ops-runner: creating ticket/inc: INC-2055 and a mitigation dashboard. panels: tenant_5xx, check_interval_effect, kvcache_evictions, worker_queue_length, per-tenant retries.
ops-runner: dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/sparkr-mitigation (internal)
alice: notes for post-incident: temporary config change, silence applied, canary success, next steps: cache sizing, retry circuit-breaker, improved per-tenant backpressure metrics.
ben: filing infra follow-up INF-712: add per-tenant circuit breaker and tunes for retry/backoff defaults.
sam: alert tuning idea: require 2m sustained >10% 5xx for tenant-5xx pages; add "noisy-tenant" auto-suppress label when we detect retry storms/backpressure to avoid noisy paging. Also create a dedupe window if same tenant floods multiple check groups.
alice: I'll update the runbook and schedule a sync at 15:30 PT to decide long-term threshold changes and dashboard ownership.
tammy: support/customer message ready, forwarding to account team.
alice: monitoring will stay on scrub for 2h; if stable we'll revert the temporary override after 1h of steady-state. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
